goal: Learn public numeric feature -> observed consequence from source family, transfer to target without target training and with new opaque action handles.

families.negative: route-reversed, same target but invert which public features mean harmful/productive

environment: Every episode generates fresh random opaque action handles independent of numeric 2-feature public physical measurement x,y each in 0..8. Ordinary rule good if y>=x+2, harmful if x>=y+2, else neutral; reversed target flips good and harm. Guaranteed >=5 productive and >=3 harmful options per episode. Engineered and simple.
policy_input: Only public action handles, paired numeric measurements, progress/damage sensor changes and goal/budget; no hidden action classes, domain ID, recipes or simulator identity hashes.

train.learning_target: public action features and observed before/after sensor deltas

limitations: Training/worlds share engineered feature-to-effect law; this is NOT learned natural perception or causal semantics.
Public action features are hand-designed useful priors but NOT hashes of action name or stable per-kind IDs.
Shifted rule and ablation must be reported even if candidate fails.
Reserved seeds are inspected after execution; no after-the-fact cherry-picking.
No real-world actions, promotion, OS integration, or claim of self-awareness.
